ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OC \perp AB$ at point O, $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$, and $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$. Find the degree measure of $\angle COE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From (1), we have
\[ \angle AOD = \angle AOC + \angle COD = 90^\circ + 45^\circ = 135^\circ, \]
\[ \because OE \text{ bisects } \angle AOD, \]
\[ \therefore \angle AOE = \frac{1}{2}\angle AOD = 67.5^\circ \]
\[ \therefore \angle COE = 90^\circ - 67.5^\circ = \boxed{22.5^\circ} \]
